proposed_widenings.name: TransportExileEffect
proposed_widenings.justification: Banishment's primary on-fail effect is transporting the target to a demiplane. The current Effect type only covers damage and none. transport_exile exists in the v4 atom inventory but has no surface type.
proposed_widenings.evidence: be transported to a harmless demiplane for the duration

proposed_widenings.name: ApplyConditionEffect (for spell activation phases)
proposed_widenings.justification: Banishment applies the Incapacitated condition while the target is banished. apply_condition exists in MasteryEffect (SaveGateRiderResult) but is not reachable from spell ActivationPhase Effect. The Effect union for spells needs an apply_condition variant.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While there, the target has the Incapacitated condition

proposed_widenings.name: Condition: incapacitated
proposed_widenings.justification: The Condition type currently only contains prone. Banishment inflicts incapacitated — a distinct SRD condition that must be expressible. At minimum a surface_widening to the Condition literal union.
proposed_widenings.evidence: the target has the Incapacitated condition

proposed_widenings.name: ReturnOnEndEffect or return_on_end lifecycle attachment
proposed_widenings.justification: When concentration ends (or spell expires), the banished target returns to its original space (or nearest unoccupied). The v4 lifecycle atom return_on_end exists but has no surface-type representation. A transport_exile Effect variant would need a returnsOnEnd flag or the lifecycle chain must express this.
proposed_widenings.evidence: When the spell ends, the target reappears in the space it left or in the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied.

proposed_widenings.name: creature_type_conditional_branch
proposed_widenings.justification: The permanent exile clause fires only when the target is an Aberration, Celestial, Elemental, Fey, or Fiend AND the spell lasts its full 1-minute duration without being broken. This dual-condition branch (creature type + spell-lasted-full-duration) has no representation in the current vocabulary. It is not a variant of an existing shape; it requires a new conditional subgraph combining creature-type filtering with duration-completion gating.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If the target is an Aberration, a Celestial, an Elemental, a Fey, or a Fiend, the target doesn't return if the spell lasts for 1 minute. The target is instead transported to a random location on a plane (DM's choice) associated with its creature type.

notes: The spell's structure (activation / save_gate) fits cleanly. All gaps are in the Effect and Condition layers. Widenings 1-4 are narrowly surface_widening: they require new variants of existing surface types (Effect, Condition) with corresponding v4 atoms already in the inventory (transport_exile, apply_condition, return_on_end). Widening 5 (creature-type conditional) is a deeper structural gap — it requires conditional branching on creature type at spell-resolution time, which is not representable in any existing family or subgraph. The permanent-exile outcome is also partially DM-agenda (the target plane is DM's choice), but the creature-type gate itself is a deterministic filter and qualifies as a real widening, not a pure dm_agenda dismissal. Upcast scaling (+1 target per slot above 4) maps cleanly to the existing SlotScaling / choose_up_to shape and requires no widening.
